payload.name: PreserveDistinctExplicitActivitiesInExtraction
payload.description: When extracting or updating memories from a dialogue message that mentions multiple distinct activities, plans, or creative intentions, preserve each explicit action rather than collapsing them into a general impression.
content: During extraction, if one message contains several distinct explicit actions, plans, or creative intentions, create a candidate for each or include all of them explicitly; do not replace concrete activities with a vague phrase like 'gets deep in thought'.

Before finalizing a candidate, re-read the source message and confirm every explicit activity or intention mentioned by the speaker is represented; if any is missing, revise the candidate rather than relying on later updates.
During CRUD, when merging or updating memories, keep distinct explicit activities as separate memory entries unless the evidence clearly supports collapsing them without losing information.

solves: The diagnosed cause is that extraction over-compressed a message containing a concrete creative plan into a vague inner-state summary, dropping the explicit plan. The reusable mechanism is over-compression of multi-part utterances during memory extraction. This applies whenever a single message states multiple distinct activities or intentions and a draft candidate would lose one; it does not apply to inferring unstated facts.
